clips.title: The story
paras: Highland Hides is an expedition contract commissioned by James Halloran, a tanner based in Menethil Harbor. Seeking superior materials from the misty mountain marshes of the Highlands, Halloran trades crafted leather goods for the tough skins of predatory Thicket Raptors.

James Halloran, a skilled tanner working out of the port town of Menethil Harbor, constantly keeps an eye out for exotic crafting materials. When word arrives of an expedition exploring forgotten ruins in the Highlands, Halloran pays less mind to ancient history and more to the formidable beasts prowling the mountain marshland. Recognizing the commercial and craft value of the wildlife, he contracts bold adventurers to venture into the mist-shrouded peaks and bring back choice pelts.

Among the fauna lurking within the Highlands, Thicket Raptors are notorious predators suited to the rugged marsh terrain. Their tough, textured skins are prized by craftsmen for specialized leatherworking. Halloran tasks travelers with tracking down these creatures and returning with four intact hides, which he uses to produce fine detailing and decorative trim for his workshop's creations.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?
I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Welcome back, adventurer. Need any leather oil for your equipment?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are some of the most impressive hides I've ever held; these will make spectacular detailing on all of my fine trim. Thank you, friend.
Try these on and take one you'd like in trade.
